reviews.text: Very nice folks. Great facility. Highly  recommend . My dog is very happy going in and coming out!!
I love bringing my dogs here. The staff is amazing and they always take great care of them while I’m traveling or just a day of fun.
Briggs is always well taken care of by his Lupe
Wonderful place - nice facilities, great customer service and excellent grooming.

Our baby Sasha absolutely loves Houston Bark Park.  She drags us to the door once getting out of the car.  We are always greeted by the kindest and friendliest staff. The facilities are always clean indoors and out. Sasha has been attending for almost a year and we could not be happier.  This is a great place to leave your fur baby!
The best daycare in Houston!  Clean. Well attended.  Fun for pups!

My baby has been coming here since he was eligible. (Age, vaccinations, temperament ). Everyone is professional, personable,  and awesome. They love each fur baby as if their own. I would not trust Astro with anyone else.
(Baby Astro’s Mom)
5/6/2026- Update. Baby Astro made another stay. They now have grooming. Try all their services. Always consistent. I never have to worry. My go to Dog Daycare, Boarding and now Grooming!

Bruno loves it here! He gets excited the second we pull up. The staff are amazing, super caring, and the customer service is always great. They take such good care of the fur babies—we wouldn’t go anywhere else! Shoutout to Lupita for always giving Bruno the BEST haircuts! 🐶💖

I have been taking my dogs to the Houston Bark Park and Daycare on 27th for a few years and recently moved out of the area.  It is a wonderful place and I would highly recommend it.  The staff are always kind, happy and welcoming.  I enjoy being able to watch the livestream of all the dogs playing and interacting.  Checking in and out is easy and efficient.  I love being able to book a quick bath or nail trim through the website.  My girls are always excited to go to daycare or boarding.  Wonderful place and wonderful people.  We will miss them!
Easy to drop off and pick up your pups. Dogs seem to enjoy their time there. We're happy they ha e something to do all day!
My dog Bae Bruh loves coming. I just mention tge name and he gets so excited. I love ❤️ my baby and he he loves Houston Bark Park and Daycare.

Made my dog feel so welcome and loved for her first visit, they saw how much my pup means to me and hearing kind words from everyone at this location, about how I can check on her. Definitely a place where my Mollie will always be going!! And on top of that she got a cute report card after her visit. She was exhausted they played with her and made her feel loved!

Daisy loves to play at Bark Park. Daisy is a 2yo lab with an abundance of  energy .we have been here about 6 months now, and we have also noticed a big improvement in "manners" they work on.    The facility is spotless and the foam cannon is a favorite. Being able to see all the fun through the facility camera system is great.   Boarding includes more fun and  bedtime treats.   The staff could not be nicer.   We are greeted with smiles  and enthusiasm for all of their  "friends".

I had previously sent my other dog there. This time my doggy was a soft fail for doggy day care - not because his behavior but because star of their bubble machine which is really loud and scared him to the point he tried to escape. My dog is not the only one who will have issues with loud noises - perhaps a suggestion to this team would be to have something that is not that loud for dogs. I believe that there are items out there which are not that loud - just a suggestion. I will have to look for a day care who does not have loud noises for play in their confined areas for dogs. All the best
Love Houston Bark park

Our dogs LOVE coming here, the staff treat them like family, know them by name on sight (and me too), and love on them like they are theirs.  100% would and have recommended.  The facility is clean and well maintained and the staff from management on down are friendly, responsive and caring.
Their Academy class is great, working on training and more focused than general daycare, and you get report cards! And craft projects!
The daycare areas and some of their boarding suite have cameras which is great when you’re missing your pup and want to see what they’re up to.  Lots of packages and options to make sure you’re getting a great value. ❤️❤️❤️ the energy corridor location of Houston Bark Park
Love this place. My sweet boy has opened up so much since coming here. And the people at the front desk and trainers are amazing. Definitely would recommend this place to all my pet parents!
Always happy with Gracie’s boarding experience at Energy Corridor Bark Park!  Glad I finally found a boarding home for her!  The staff all take extra attention to make her feel comfortable.

We love Houston Barkpark Energy Corridor location. Everyone there is great and truly pays attention to our dogs to take care of them. They also treat our dog like their own, always excited to see him when we drop him off.
Nice facility
Love Bark Park! My 4 are there weekly, highly recommended!!!
It’s totally awesome when I picked up Duke you could tell the joy of having a Great Day.. I look forward to taking him more often so he can have a Great time

We are so happy we found Bark Park for daycare and boarding! The staff is wonderful and it’s clear they truly care about the dogs. Being able to check in on the cameras gives me so much peace of mind, and our pup always comes home happy and tired from playing.

First time taking my dog here, he had a blast! My dog is about a year old, 60 pounds, Shepherd mix. He did their initial all day evaluation and interacted well with the other dogs. There are many different activities for the dogs and lots of interaction with the staff, who are friendly and professional.

Before discovering Houston Bark Park (Energy Corridor), taking my dog Arthur to any dog care facility was a battle. It was heartbreaking and exhausting.
But everything changed with Houston Bark Park. The first visit was for his temperament evaluation, and yes, it was the usual struggle. But by the second day, Arthur practically jumped out of the car as soon as I pulled into the parking lot. I couldn’t believe it
The staff is phenomenal, kind, attentive, and clearly passionate about what they do. The live-stream cameras are a fantastic touch, giving me peace of mind and a glimpse into Arthur’s day.
I highly recommend Houston Bark Park to any dog owner looking for a place that truly understands and cares for your pup.
The staff here are wonderful! Amy the groomer is amazing !!Highly recommend all their services!

Bark Park, Energy Corridor, they are super nice and I love The concept and love the facility. It’s just crazy expensive with all of the add on’s. Our two dogs, from Friday at 2:00 - Monday at 2:00 was $563! They are boarding but you still have to pay for the full day of play. Then although we paid for three full days of boarding ($172.50 each) then we paid for three full days for them to play ($75 each) then two Half days for $20 each. Then on top of all that  they charged us $20 (conscience fee) for getting there at 2:00 to drop them off, then $8 to bag their food individually, which I would Have done if I had Known. This nickel and dime’ing is crazy.

They have always been wonderful anf patient with our shy/nervous dog. They gave him the necessary time and space and he has been going there for 6+ years now and I think he likes it more than home sometimes.
The staff are friendly and our buddy loves it here. They have cameras that you can watch while away (we get addicted to watching him). It appears to be a really clean environment too.

Here is Autumn’s first year at the Shepherd location. The staff is amazing and beyond helpful. Autumn adores them all! She has grown so much here. At first, she was shy, but now it’s definitely her second home.

I would absolutely recommend Houston Bark Park to everyone, but especially to those with demanding jobs. It was such a weight lifted off my shoulders when I asked if she could be boarded during severe inclement weather due to my work schedule, and they said yes, of course. I literally cried, and the ladies were so sweet and comforting.

Her first inclement weather boarding experience was during the snow, and she had a blast! When boarding, I highly recommend getting picture updates when boarding and of course do every photoshoot!

I have experienced nothing less than exceptional care. They always go above and beyond for both the little ones and their pawrents. Thank you again to the staff at the Shepherd location. I truly appreciate y’all for the love and care you give to little Miss Autumn 🧡

Our dog absolutely loves it here, the Shepherd location is his home away from home. Quinn has been a daycare participant for over 2 years (2x a week). Recently we had a home fire and when the staff found out, they treated us like family. They went above & beyond for Quinn knowing that these things impact the whole family. I can’t praise the staff enough.
I love this place they are super friendly and helpful.   My dogs love it there and I love how I can always check on them and watch them during the day on the cameras.
Such a great place to take your fur baby! Staff is always so attentive and friendly! Would 100% recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy and safe boarding/ daycare for your pet.

2nd time using Houston Bark Park for boarding my pup so in love of how happy he comes home used to use another boarding place and he would look dirty and sad like he cried the whole time we were gone and hated to be dropped off but here he didnt hesitate to go in and once picked up looked like he was in great hands for sure will continue to board him here knowing i will come home to a happy pup.
Took our dog for an assessment. From what i could tell they never had him out with other dogs at all. We never saw him on the cameras. They told us “he sniffs too much”

When Moose comes home with a smile every time I pick him up from Houston Bark Park - there are no words!  He loves going to daycare and that brings so much peace of mind that he's spending his day in pure joy :)
I absolutely love taking my dog to Houston Bark Park. Everyone is so friendly. Brisket has the best time whenever he goes to daycare. 20/10 recommend!

We never wrote a review while our dog was at Houston Bark Park, but we truly loved bringing her to here. We don’t have a big yard, so taking her once a week gave her a little more space and freedom. She didn’t even play much, she mostly just sunbathed and relaxed, which made her so happy. It really made life easier for us and gave her something to look forward to. She always came home exhausted.

After she unexpectedly passed, I reached out and didn’t hear back right away, which was hard in the moment. But when I followed up, they immediately called and offered a sincere apology—it was an oversight, and I appreciated how kindly they handled it. It just reaffirmed how much they truly care about the dogs (and their people) who come through their doors.

I boarded my dog here over the weekend and had the BEST experience! The staff was so kind, attentive, and genuinely seemed to love every dog like their own. It was very clear my pup had an absolute blast. The facility is clean, safe, and super dog-friendly — it truly feels like a little vacation for your dog. I’ll definitely be bringing mine back here anytime I need to travel. Highly recommend!
Love HBP! They take phenomenal care of my little Giuseppe. All locations are great but I’m partial to the Energy Corridor location - their staff is A++!
They take very good care of my little Giuseppe! Weight off my shoulders when he’s safely there.

Barkpark at Energy Corridor on Dairy Ashford is an excellent place. Our dog Sophia is very social and loves being around other dogs. She gets lots of exercise as she is super high energy. The cost is reasonable for what the services are.  I highly recommend Houston Barkpark.

We needed to find a place to board my dog for the weekend, which I was really nervous about. Fortunately, I heard good things about Bark Park on Reddit and decided to try it out. After our initial experience with the daycare, we felt little concerns about her staying overnight. The staff at the Shepherd location was warm and friendly and they sent home a free report after her trial daycare. She didn’t seem anxious/stressed when picking her up, which she typically is after visiting the vet/groomer without us. The cameras made me feel more assured that I could drop in during the day to see how she’s doing. All in all a great experience! We’ll definitely use them again if need a place to board her!

Started bringing my pup (Biko) here and we love it! It’s comforting knowing your dog is in good hands and gets to mingle all day with others (she also loves the bubble machine).

I appreciate how they have cameras indoors and outdoors if you’d like to watch your dog while you’re away.

She is super tired when i pick her up after a long day of play. Highly recommend bringing your doggies here :)
Great place for our puppy! Staff is amazing!

This place is da bomb! I have 9 yo GSD and 3 yo mixed breed rescued from local group. Prabu, the GSD has been growing up attending HBP, initially at Maxie location since he was 6 months old. Then to S Dairy Ashford location since last fall for both pups. Tobi, was rescued from the street, and was scared of everything and everyone. He gained his confidence since attending daycare. When I brought him to HBP, he was scared of males. However, a few weeks into it, I picked them up and my pup was so happy toward male employees without reservation nor fear. Both dogs have been looking forward to their daycare days, knowing they can play with friends, dogs and humans. Thank you for taking care of them, HBP.
